title: B is for Bethlehem — Where Baby Jesus Was Born
objective: Students will learn the letter B and the Bible word Bethlehem, the town where Jesus was born.
content: Today we are learning the letter B! Can you say B? B is for Bethlehem!
Bethlehem is a special little town. It is where baby Jesus was born! Mary and Joseph traveled a long way to get to Bethlehem.
When they got there, there was no room for them at the inn, so baby Jesus was born in a stable and laid in a manger. Angels sang and shepherds came to see Him!
activity: Color a picture of the letter B. Draw a picture of baby Jesus in the manger in Bethlehem.
discussion: Can you say the letter B?
Who came to visit baby Jesus?
